$description: C1XX Foundations · shape. Radius, border and elevation. Shadow colours reference semantic tokens so each theme tints its own shadows (the site uses warm ink, Syncline uses its navy) without changing the geometry.

5.$description: Device frames, hero media. Syncline's 28/32/34 collapse here.

hairline.$description: The only width for rules and borders. Kept as a literal in CSS.

emphasis.$description: Progress indicators, focus rings, selected state.

elevation.$description: Three levels. Offsets and blurs are fixed; the colour comes from {color.shadow} in the active theme. Level 0 is no shadow (default for a flat editorial surface).

1.$description: Resting card, chip. Replaces Syncline's 10px/26px cluster.

2.$description: Hovered card, floating control, bottom sheet. Replaces 12–18px / 28–44px cluster.

3.$description: Modal, device frame, project cover. Replaces 30–42px / 80–110px cluster.

inset-hairline.$description: Border drawn as inset shadow so it does not affect layout. Used on media containers.
